inputs.original_text: New York City’s decision to release an illegal immigrant gang member, despite the danger he posed, shows what happens when sanctuary politics take priority over public safety. ICE had to step in while local officials obstructed federal enforcement. Families should not bear the risk because officials put ideology ahead of their basic duty: protect citizens and uphold the law.
inputs.modified_text: This is what happens when sanctuary ideology is allowed to override the most basic responsibility of government: protecting the public. New York City released an illegal immigrant gang member despite the danger he posed, leaving ICE to step in while local officials obstructed federal enforcement. Families should not have to live with the consequences of officials choosing political posturing over public safety and the rule of law.
